Requirement: The service shall start within **10 seconds**.
Acceptance Criteria: Measured from process launch until ready status.

Requirement:
The service shall retain logs for:
- 14 days
- 1 GB maximum
The service shall accept HTTP connections.
Acceptance Criteria: A client can connect over port 8080.

Requirement: The legacy export shall remain available.
Acceptance Criteria: The legacy command produces a text file.
